label: Flux out of a closed surface
section: Flux out of a closed surface

visual.title: Flux out of a closed surface
visual.caption: The source field leaves every closed loop. The outward flux grows with the radius, and the divergence times the enclosed area gives the same value, which is the divergence theorem in the plane.

predict.question: The divergence theorem equates the flux out of a closed surface to:
options: The triple integral of the divergence inside
The surface area of the boundary
predict.explain: ∮F·n dS = ∭div F dV. For F = (x, y) the outward flux 2πr² equals the divergence 2 times the area πr².
